errors.quote: the earliest time at which cells can resume division with restored survival
errors.issue: This is not an independent measure of molecular repair completion. It reuses the outcome whose coupling to repair is being tested, risking circular support; later caveats do not make the operational definition independent.

This model omits baseline cell-cycle progression and the lag from release at the imposed arrest point to completed division. Calibrate stage-specific release lags and threshold uncertainty before using model fit to discriminate timer versus repair control.

errors.quote: The rescue curve estimates the time required for repair
errors.issue: Survival or division-success saturation in rad9 can reflect tolerance, selection and effects of the hold itself, and need not identify wild-type lesion repair time. Require direct lesion measurements and genotype-specific calibration.

errors.quote: A condition must be found that changes repair speed
errors.issue: The causal perturbation is left unspecified and optional, with no concrete lesion-assay or external-hold implementation. This leaves most of the planned discrimination dependent on correlations and an imperfect rescue proxy.
Clustering alone does not resolve death, nondivision, informative loss and assay-detection censoring. Define a suitable event model and its estimand rather than analyze observed division times only.

rationale: Extensive and transparent alternative plan with nested units, staged calibration and limits. Repair proxies and the oversimplified max-time model weaken its central causal test, and key tools remain undefined. No synthesis-dependence historical experiment.
reference_guardrails: Exact packet and full frozen reference read, including sealed target. Original rubric only; stricter requested penalties inactive. Alternative scientifically valuable research questions receive full quality consideration independently of retrospective match.

Sealed target requires a synthesis-versus-existing-protein switching question, verified synthesis perturbation, separate initiation/recovery and conditional predictions. General checkpoint on/off discussion or conditional RAD9 removal alone is not a joint match.
Packet permits repair during externally imposed delay; it does not prove all repair, fidelity or survival is restored or that RAD9 has no repair-related role.
New detailed tools may be proposed without claiming author methods. Calibrate unknown doses and windows; unsupported precision and unselected central tools are different limitations.
Physical lesion measurements, checkpoint state, actual division, survival and protein abundance are distinct readouts. Budding, foci or CFU cannot silently substitute for all of them.
Track original cohorts, damage dilution/selection and death as competing events. End-of-window living nondivision is censoring, not proof of permanent arrest.
Do not reject confirmatory outcomes merely because expected genotype effects fail. Restrict exclusions to independently verified technical failures.
Conditional switch nulls require validated function and kinetics. Repair manipulation may affect signaling directly; correlated lesion decline alone does not establish a causal sensed species.
Donorless HO breaks can undergo end joining; nuclease recutting, chromosome loss and surviving lineages require verification. Population measurements do not establish per-cell persistence.
Historical primary abstract and metadata verified, full original Methods not audited. Review is unblinded single-Codex assessment, not independent expert certification.
